meta.title: Fire Simulation Training Systems
meta.description: TZJ fire simulation training systems use gas and electronic flame and smoke effects to recreate multiple fire scenarios—safe, clean, and repeatable for high-frequency instruction and routine drill programs.

hero.title: Fire Simulation Training Systems
hero.description: Safe, clean, and repeatable—bring high-frequency instruction and routine drills to any site with simulated flame and smoke.

overview.title: Not every drill needs live fire
overview.description: For equipment handling, initial attack, and workforce training, simulation delivers a strong balance of realism and control—safer, cleaner, and more cost-effective.
overview.lead: Fire intensity and smoke levels are adjustable, so one system covers multiple fire scenarios and training tiers.
overview.body: Complements CFBT live-fire facilities: simulation handles high-frequency instruction; live fire handles advanced tactical training—a stronger combined program.

featuresSection.title: Six advantages of simulation systems
featuresSection.description: Programmable smoke, heat, alarm, and evacuation scenarios — safe and repeatable.

features.title: Programmable smoke
features.desc: Adjustable smoke density simulates visibility challenges from introductory lessons through advanced drills.

features.title: Adjustable heat
features.desc: Scale heat intensity to train thermal stress recognition without solid-fuel live fire.

features.title: Alarm integration
features.desc: Fire alarm and detection systems trigger realistic response sequences during simulation drills.

features.title: Multi-scenario programs
features.desc: Simulate pan fires, gas, electrical, kitchen, and other fire types from a single facility.

features.title: Evacuation drills
features.desc: Support evacuation, escape, and self-rescue exercises with controlled conditions.

features.title: Central control & safety
features.desc: Safety interlocks, emergency shutoff, and instructor control keep training auditable and safe.

configSection.title: Tailored simulation layouts for your site
configSection.description: Engineers configure simulation rooms, props, and control systems based on training volume and site constraints.
configSection.point1: Modular simulation cells combine smoke generators, heat sources, and scenario props for flexible program design.
configSection.point2: Central control with safety interlocks enables rapid reset — supporting large-volume, routine, repeatable training.
